sloka: दृष्ट्वा तु राघवः पत्नीं कल्याणेन समन्विताम् ।प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे साधु साध्विति चाब्रवीत् ।। ७.४२.२९ ॥
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tu rāghavaḥ patnīṁ kalyāṇena samanvitām ।praharṣamatulaṁ lebhe sādhu sādhviti cābravīt ।। 7.42.29 ॥

translations.english: Then, adorned with various ornaments and garments, Sita approached Rama, just as Shachi approaches the thousand-eyed Indra seated in heaven.
